claims.quote: Known only from a single cave system (Tham Sai Yok Noi) near the town of Nam Tok Sai Yok Noi, Sai Yok district, Kanchanaburi Province, Thailand.

regions.name: Mae Klong
regions.quote: The headwater stream running through the cave is part of the Khwae Noi river basin, itself a tributary of the upper Mae Klong system.
